# Editas Medicine

> Editas Medicine is a leading CRISPR gene editing company developing transformative genomic medicines using Cas9 and Cas12a technologies.

Editas Medicine pioneers CRISPR-based therapeutics with research partnerships including Harvard and the Broad Institute. The company maintains offices in Cambridge, MA and Boulder, CO, and is actively advancing clinical programs like EDIT-401 through its drug pipeline.

- Cas9 and Cas12a technology
